## Timing and later evidence

The fourteen original second readings ran from 28 seconds (255) to 2 minutes 34 seconds (249) per sheet. These intervals are shorter than the requested several minutes per page. Every sheet received the separate pre-witness follow-up collation recorded above. Five close-ups originally served more than one mark on 246 and 256. During the final evidence review their fifteen marked places were also isolated individually, with the first close-up retained for context. The independent register gives the pixel boxes. This later work was done after the witness hash. Five reading questions raised in the notes are recorded under Q1–Q5 there.
